name: PEM & DER Converter
description: Convert between PEM text and DER binary, and report the PEM labels found in the input.

examples.label: Convert a leaf certificate from PEM to DER

hints.der: DER is binary, so the output is carried as base64 to fit into JSON.
hints.single: Converting to DER accepts a single block only: DER cannot hold several objects.
hints.safe: Only the encoding changes; the material is neither parsed nor modified.

faq.q: What follows BEGIN in a PEM header?
faq.a: The object type identifier, for example CERTIFICATE, PRIVATE KEY, PUBLIC KEY or CERTIFICATE REQUEST.

faq.q: Why does DER output only take one block?
faq.a: DER encodes a single object, so several PEM blocks cannot be packed into one DER.

faq.q: What is the type filter for?
faq.a: When the input mixes certificates and keys, it keeps only the blocks of the chosen type.
